items.title: Cisco Just Gave Investors 3 Big Reasons to Be Bullish
items.summary: Cisco just posted its strongest earnings surprise in years, yet the stock dropped sharply the next day. Whether that selloff is a warning sign or a rare entry point comes down to three catalysts that most investors are overlooking.

items.title: Super Micro's Margin Surprise Is Already Guided Back Down
items.summary: The mix that produced it included contracts pushed out of the June quarter, and the September guide already takes the margin back down.

items.title: Will Ciena's Rising Backlog Improve Revenue Visibility Into 2027?
items.summary: CIEN enters 2027 with a $7.7B backlog, strong orders and new products supporting revenue outlook as AI fuels network demand.

items.title: The Quiet Winner of the AI Buildout Just Posted Its Best Year Ever
items.summary: While flashier AI names grabbed headlines, Cisco quietly rewired itself for the infrastructure boom and just delivered numbers that stopped Wall Street's skeptics cold. The question now is whether the market has actually caught up to what the business has become.

items.title: Arista Networks Stock Is Priced For Its Peak Margin
items.summary: Arista Networks stock sits at its high on a multiple past anything in its ten-year record, while the margin that price depends on is already at the top of its range.

items.title: The Number Cisco Stopped Leading With Explains What You Now Own
items.summary: The recurring-revenue share management once put front and center has slipped while hyperscaler orders became the story.

items.title: Fidelity’s Contrafund, FCNTX, Bet Against the Crowd and Got Enormous Doing It
items.summary: Fidelity Contrafund built a legendary reputation by zigging while Wall Street zagged, but managing $157.8 billion forces some uncomfortable questions about whether a fund this massive can still bet against the crowd without becoming it.
